name: container_high_low_change_cpu_usage
title: Container high low change CPU usage
description: This alert rule monitors the absolute change in CPU usage within a time window and triggers an alert when the change exceeds 25%.

source.upstream_alert: Container high low change CPU usage
source.upstream_query: (abs((sum by (instance, name) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{name!=""}[1m])) * 100) - (sum by (instance, name) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{name!=""}[1m] offset 1m)) * 100)) or abs((sum by (instance, name) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{name!=""}[1m])) * 100) - (sum by (instance, name) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{name!=""}[5m] offset 1m)) * 100))) > 25
source.upstream_description: This alert rule monitors the absolute change in CPU usage within a time window and triggers an alert when the change exceeds 25%.

query_condition.promql: abs((sum by (instance, name) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{name!=""}[1m])) * 100) - (sum by (instance, name) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{name!=""}[1m] offset 1m)) * 100)) or abs((sum by (instance, name) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{name!=""}[1m])) * 100) - (sum by (instance, name) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{name!=""}[5m] offset 1m)) * 100))

notes: 25 percentage-point threshold is a rough default; acceptable CPU volatility depends on your workload's nature (bursty batch jobs vs steady services) — adjust based on your baseline.
